create_speech_to_text_processor: create a KyutaiSpeechToTextProcessor instance with a feature extractor and tokenizer for speech-to-text inference
process_audio_to_text: process raw audio input through the processor to produce model-ready input tensors and token ids
decode_generated_tokens: decode model output token ids into human-readable transcript strings using the wrapped tokenizer
configure_processor_sampling_rate: configure the processor kwargs with a custom sampling rate for audio feature extraction
set_processor_return_tensors: set the processor common kwargs to return pt, tf, or np tensors from featurize and decode calls
